svg.text: categorical - General categorical groups, line plots, bar plots, scatter groups.

categorical - Dense comparison plots where groups must separate clearly.

sequential - Mechanical/thermal/CFD scalar fields: temperature, pressure, velocity magnitude, and stress intensity.
diverging - Materials, design space, phase maps, optimization landscapes, and signed performance deltas.
categorical - Biology, pathway, mechanism, cell-state, and schematic figures.
categorical - Clinical cohorts, demographic comparisons, survival plots, and restrained medical figures.
sequential - Continuous environmental, spatial, intensity, or model-output data.
